versions.changelog:
Cantonese text-to-speech skill initial release:

- Convert Mandarin or Cantonese text to spoken Cantonese in MP3 format.
- Automatically adapts Mandarin or written-style input to natural Cantonese expressions and grammar.
- Offers four speaking styles: normal, slow (sad/calm), fast (happy/excited), and angry (impatient).
- Allows selection of different voices: default HiuMaan (female), HiuGaai (female), or WanLung (male).
- Simple CLI usage with clear parameters and examples provided.
